cases.applies: All surfaces that switch or present Space/Profile content.
steps: Use separate synthetic regular Profiles with the same fixture origin and Spaces sharing a Profile.
Record the actual native top-level identity continuously while switching Profiles in one window, including hidden/unmapped browser windows.
Navigate, invoke chrome and Profile services, present empty attachments and empty contexts.
cases.oracle: Same native top-level survives without a backing/replacement browser window. Real BrowserContext, toolbar, command receiver and session owner match the presented Profile; shared-Profile services are shared and distinct-Profile storage is isolated. Empty contexts retain the host and disable page actions. Logical Model selection is insufficient.
